description: Group of 6 and we would like to represent our country Oman globally.
summary: Our project is MoonLab AI, an interactive internet site designed to make NASA’s forgotten equipment at the Moon and Mars understandable and enjoyable for people of different ages and backgrounds. Instead of wide of lengthy technical texts, the platform based on easy descriptions, images, animations and audio to give an explanation for every equipment or machine. Also, the platform designed with accessibility in mind, offering audio-based and visual materials to guide users with disabilities. The platform interface and interact features may be developed by the use of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with 3D/animation technology to visualize the equipment. AI can guide the platform by helping organize the complex space information in simpler and suitable way. Data from NASA’s publicly available to be used in building the objects information. This makes it realistic to create working prototype for the hackathon and future development. Our innovation combines space education, accessibility, animation, audio and AI in single platform. Instead of searching wide technical data, we permit users to see, hear, explore and have interaction with stories behind NASA’s forgotten equipments. This creates a digital museum to explore space, make objects that are no longer active accessible again and ensure that their stories are not forgotten.
details: The purpose of MoonLap AI is to make the process of learning about space exploration fun and exciting for everyone, including school-going children. Our Project enables users to know the stories of abandoned machinery on the Moon and on Mars and their significance to space exploration. Another benefit that makes it stand out from the crowd is that the interface is very user-friendly and easy-to-navigate. It incorporates clear and understandable language and nice graphics with interesting animations. The interactive elements allow you to engage yourself in learning using graphic and moving elements in your own way. There is also one feature that enables the user to hear the story being told rather than reading it. It may also benefit both the teachers and the students through the processes of adding interest to the science class lessons. Rather than just studying theories from textbooks, the students will be able to learn about missions to outer space and technology that is used there. This way, we can spark their interests in science and technology. A second impact is the preservation of history related to space exploration. Although many of the machines no longer work, their history and accomplishments are not to be ignored. With the help of it, we can pass down their history to future generations as well as their contributions to space. In general, Our Project will help make the study of space easier and more enjoyable for all individuals. With the inclusion of such components as simple text, animations, and audio, it can make the process of studying space both more interesting and fun.
